name: 2D platformer
summary: A side-view game where a character runs and jumps across platforms under gravity, avoids hazards, collects items and reaches a goal.
entities: gravity, jump force, horizontal acceleration, friction
mechanics: Gravity pulls the player down; grounded state resets jump availability.
Jump applies an impulse; variable jump height or coyote time improves feel.
Horizontal movement accelerates and decelerates; collision resolves on both axes.
Platforms are solid from the correct sides; one-way platforms are optional.
Hazards/enemies damage or respawn the player; collectibles increment score.
Reaching the goal completes the level; restart resets the level state.
ux: Keyboard arrows/WASD + space, and touch controls on mobile.
Show lives/score/level in a HUD; pause and restart.
Keep the player visible with a camera that follows smoothly.
pitfalls: Tunneling through platforms at high speed; sticking to walls.
Jump that feels floaty or impossible; no coyote time.
Collision handled only on one axis; player sinks into the floor.
Game loop tied to frame rate; physics breaks on high-refresh displays.
Input stuck after focus loss; restart not resetting velocity/position.
defaults: 2D side-scroller, keyboard controls, canvas or DOM.
Three short levels, one enemy type, coins, checkpoint at the start.

ask.en: Which controls should the game support?

suffix.en: Support keyboard and on-screen touch controls.
suffix.tr: Klavye ve ekran üstü dokunmatik kontrolleri destekle.

ask.en: How many levels should the first version have?

suffix.tr: Tek ve tam oynanabilir bir seviye yap.

suffix.en: Build three short levels with a level select.
suffix.tr: Seviye seçimli üç kısa seviye yap.

verification: Player falls under gravity and lands on a platform without sinking or tunneling.
Jump raises the player and returns to the ground; it cannot be repeated in mid-air.
Horizontal movement stops at walls; one-way platforms behave as configured.
Collecting an item increments the HUD exactly once.
Hazard/enemy contact respawns or damages exactly once.
Reaching the goal completes the level; restart resets position, velocity, score and enemies.
The loop keeps a stable frame rate and input stops cleanly on blur.
